description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Draven''' enters an adrenaline rush, gaining [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 3 seconds as well as decaying [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed and [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosting]] for 1.5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Draven enters an adrenaline rush, gaining  bonus attack speed for 3 seconds as well as decaying  bonus movement speed and ghosting for 1.5 seconds.

description2.raw: Catching a ''[[File:Draven Spinning Axe.png|20xpx|border|link=Draven#Spinning Axe|An icon for Draven's ability Spinning Axe]] [[Draven#Spinning Axe|Spinning Axe]]'' resets ''Blood Rush's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown.
description2.text: Catching a Spinning Axe resets Blood Rush's  cooldown.
